tasks.label: marketplace_a
tasks.task: You are a payments-UX researcher studying Marketplace A.com. Do NOT log in, do NOT check out, do NOT buy anything. Study how Marketplace A communicates PAYMENT and BENEFIT options to shoppers BEFORE checkout. Visit the homepage, search a grocery item ('milk') and a health/OTC item ('allergy relief' or 'FSA eligible'), open 1-2 product detail pages, and view the cart. Capture: every payment method advertised anywhere (footer 'Marketplace A payment products', help, PDP, cart) — cards, Marketplace A Pay, Apple/Google Pay, PayPal, Affirm/BNPL, EBT/SNAP on Marketplace A Fresh, HSA/FSA (Marketplace A has an FSA/HSA store), OTC, gift cards, 'Shop with Points'; how EBT/SNAP, HSA/FSA, and OTC eligibility are badged or filtered (look for an 'FSA/HSA eligible' badge/store and 'SNAP EBT eligible' labels); any benefit tracker; payment-linked promotions; wallet/express prompts; and how hard it is to know eligibility/savings before checkout. Quote exact on-page text where possible. IMPORTANT: when finished, return your result via the done tool as a FLAT JSON object matching the schema. Keep each string field to 1-3 concise sentences. Use the string 'none observed' for anything not seen. Do NOT nest objects and do NOT exceed the schema fields.

tasks.label: marketplace_b
tasks.task: You are a payments-UX researcher studying Marketplace B.com. Do NOT log in, do NOT check out, do NOT buy anything (a login wall blocks checkout — stay before it). Study how Marketplace B communicates PAYMENT and BENEFIT options BEFORE checkout. Visit the homepage, open a retailer storefront (e.g., /store/merchant_c/storefront), search 'milk' and a health item ('vitamins'), open product pages, open the cart drawer, and also read the public help/landing pages: marketplace-b.example.invalid/paypal, marketplace-b.example.invalid/p/venmo, marketplace-b.example.invalid/lp/klarna, marketplace-b.example.invalid/help/article/ebt-snap-payments, and the FSA/HSA help. Capture: every payment method advertised — cards, Apple/Google Pay, PayPal, Venmo, Cash App, Klarna BNPL, EBT/SNAP, HSA/FSA, OTC Network card, Marketplace B gift cards, Marketplace B Card Network/points; how EBT/SNAP eligibility is surfaced (SNAP-eligible filter/badges); how HSA/FSA and OTC are surfaced; any 'use your benefits' prompts and benefit tracker; cart economics messaging (delivery/service fees, $0-fee thresholds, order minimum); payment-linked promotions; and effort to learn eligibility before checkout. Quote exact on-page text where possible. IMPORTANT: when finished, return your result via the done tool as a FLAT JSON object matching the schema. Keep each string field to 1-3 concise sentences. Use 'none observed' for anything not seen. Do NOT nest objects and do NOT exceed the schema fields.
